title: Applicationcomponent assigned-to Applicationinterface
description: The component handles the requests that arrive through an access point it does not itself declare, such as a member component behind a collaboration's gateway route or a shared message channel, so the interface's traffic is carried out by this component. Use provides instead when the component's own codebase declares and exposes the access point.
x-dr-evidence: A gateway, ingress or shared-channel configuration owned by a collaboration or another component routes the interface's requests to this component's handlers.
